findings.evidence: The declaration maps a projective presentation to a projective presentation, while `mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Projective/Basic.lean:220-225` names the analogous construction `Adjunction.mapProjectivePresentation`.
findings.fix: Rename it to `map` in the `ProjectivePresentation` namespace (and rename `mapAdjunction_K/P/i/p` to `map_K/P/i/p`), or use the established `mapProjectivePresentation` terminology consistently.
findings.issue: `ProjectivePresentation.mapAdjunction` names the construction after the adjunction used to prove it works, contrary to the rule that names describe their result; Mathlib calls the corresponding operation `Adjunction.mapProjectivePresentation`.

summary: The new presentation transport API uses a proof-oriented name instead of the established Mathlib term for this construction.
